subject: Maintenance slice coordination and rollback readiness
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Maintenance slice coordination and rollback readiness

Team —

We have a narrow maintenance window next month for the Acme Health private deployment (pinned v1.12.3 -> v1.13.0). I want to align on a minimal-impact slice that lets us push the security and kernel-level fixes + version pin update without a full fleet unpin. Key asks:

- Confirm the 11/15 02:00-04:00 UTC quiet window with Acme (they prefer US evenings).
- Agree on the evacuation slice definition: 2 control-plane nodes + 6 inference pods in staging -> exercise rollback on canary before wider slices.
- Finalize rollback criteria (latency spike >30% sustained for 3m, error rate >1% 5m, any KV cache corruption observed).
- Assign owners for preflight, net-quiesce, post-checks.

I've attached a working runbook draft and a simplified network quiesce diagram. Please review and reply with gaps/edits by EOD Friday so I can share with Acme.

Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Platform Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: maintenance_runbook_v2.pdf (runbook draft), network-quiesce-diagram.png (VGW / BGP drain steps)
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, monica_patel@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-02T11:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Maintenance slice coordination and rollback readiness

Thanks Markus — quick responses inline and a short checklist: 

- Window: 11/15 02:00-04:00 UTC is OK from our side, but confirm Acme's internal backup retention job (they run DB snapshot at 02:30 UTC). Recommend shifting to 03:00-05:00 UTC if we need DB quiesce.
- Evacuation slice: +1 canary pod (total 7 across the slice) — run two full inference load tests (short seq lengths) pre/post and KV validation with a synthetic prompt set.
- Rollback criteria: add 'failed model hash verification on startup' and 'unexpected HSM/KMS access errors' to the list.
- Owners: preflight = monica, network quiesce = aditya, rollback helm choreography = me.

I'll push a trimmed preflight checklist into the runbook and add the exact k8s drain commands we use for private clusters.

Karthik

On attachments: I suggest adding a short script snippet that validates KV cache integrity (I can paste that into the runbook).
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@acmehealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-03T15:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Maintenance slice coordination and rollback readiness

Markus / team —

Thanks for the heads up. Acme is ok with 11/15 but we cannot move our nightly snapshot job — it must stay at 02:30 UTC. Can you confirm whether the maintenance requires DB quiesce or just inference traffic quiesce? If you need the DB quiet we will need to postpone to 11/16 or perform the DB snapshot earlier.

Also, please ensure you route logs to our syslog forwarder (syslog.acmehealth.net) during the window — our security team will audit.

Sara Liu
SRE Manager, Acme Health

External contact: ops@acmehealth.com
From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-05T08:46:00Z
Subject: Re: Maintenance slice coordination and rollback readiness

All — updated runbook attached and changes summarized:

- Kept target window at 11/15 02:00-04:00 UTC but added a DB-safety check: if Acme snapshot is scheduled at 02:30 and cannot be moved, we will limit the slice to inference nodes only (no DB migrations, no config writes that touch persistent store).
- Added the KV-integrity check script (sha256 checks on startup, sample prompts, and result hash expectations).
- Network quiesce changes: 2-step BGP withdrawal then flow-terminate for inference subnets — see diagram.
- Rollback playbook: helm rollback + pin back to v1.12.3 + cache invalidation + forced model load on evicted pods.
- Post-window telemetry: 30m latency/err rate watch, then 6h business-hours monitoring.

Attachments: maintenance_runbook_v2.pdf (updated)

Please confirm owners again and I will publish the final runbook to the Confluence page and send the signed maintenance notice to Acme's security team.

-Monica
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: Sara Liu <sara.liu@acmehealth.com>, Ops Team <ops@mercantile.io>
Date: 2026-11-08T16:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Maintenance slice coordination and rollback readiness

Appreciate the updates — I approve the plan as-is with the following action items before 11/12 EOD: 

- Monica: publish final runbook to the Confluence link and add versioned artifact (tag v1.0) + run the preflight KV script in staging by 11/10.
- Karthik: prepare helm rollback runbook snippet and smoke test harness (include the exact metrics to compare).
- Aditya: confirm routing to syslog.acmehealth.net and validate BGP withdrawal steps on the test router.
- Sara/Acme: confirm DB snapshot immutability at 02:30 remains acceptable; if not, notify by 11/10 17:00 UTC.

I'll send the signed maintenance notice to Acme security once Monica publishes the final doc. If any of the rollback criteria trigger during the window we will abort and execute rollback immediately.

Markus
